# Alternatives Analysis Specification

> A decision-matrix-driven decision record (weighted sum model with sensitivity and robustness analysis). Three variants exist; fetch the raw Markdown of the one that fits the decision.

- [Software variant](https://alternatives.jonashw.dev/software.md): for software architecture and engineering decisions (primary).
- [General variant](https://alternatives.jonashw.dev/general.md): domain-general, for decisions in any field.
- [Storytelling variant](https://alternatives.jonashw.dev/storytelling.md): for story decisions (scripts, cutscenes, characters, lore), including decisions made of parts.
- [Criteria Ranker](https://alternatives.jonashw.dev/toolkit/criteria-ranker.html): a one-page tool where the decision owner sets the weights by answering pairwise "which matters more?" questions. It asks "If you could only keep one of these, which?" when more than three criteria tie, and can turn must-haves into pass or fail gates. Replace its `DATA` block to reuse it; it also holds a parent decision with its parts (`?example=parts`). Engine: [pairwise.js](https://alternatives.jonashw.dev/toolkit/pairwise.js). Before copying or changing the ranker, read [Supported use](https://alternatives.jonashw.dev/toolkit/README.md): publish the single file as it is, change only `DATA`, title and header, keep `DATA.key`, and upgrade older copies in place with `toolkit/upgrade.mjs`.
- [Try the Criteria Ranker with your own criteria](https://alternatives.jonashw.dev/toolkit/README.md): no copy needed. Prepare a link for the person: `https://alternatives.jonashw.dev/toolkit/criteria-ranker.html#data=` + base64url (no padding) of the criteria set's JSON, e.g. `{"title":"…","criteria":[{"id":"COST","name":"R1 …"}]}`; add `alternatives` and per-criterion `scores` (0 to 5) for weights and a winner. Schema: [criteria.schema.json](https://alternatives.jonashw.dev/toolkit/criteria.schema.json). Use `#`, never `?`: the fragment never reaches the server. Keep links under about 2,000 characters, otherwise give the JSON for the page's paste box. Read "Try it with your own criteria" in the README for the pitfalls.
